mean-interval-claims.alt: Three horizontal confidence intervals for the true mean fill weight of cereal boxes, each centered at the sample mean 495.9 grams: 90% from 493.57 to 498.23, 95% from 493.10 to 498.70 and 99% from 492.13 to 499.67 grams. A dashed vertical line at 500 grams, the label value, lies to the right of all three intervals.
